properties.name: altavista:sbom:licence-note
properties.value: Read from usr/share/doc/libssl3/copyright inside the .deb. 'Files: *' and 'Files: debian/*' are Apache-2.0 (the shared libraries). The 'Artistic or GPL-1+' stanza covers 'Files: external/perl/Text-Template-1.56/*', a Perl module in the OpenSSL SOURCE tree used by its build; the .deb holds no file from it (its data member is the three engines, the two shared libraries, legacy.so and three doc files). The remaining 'License:' fields are the full texts of those same licences. Ruled by the lead (question 250's native round): carrying the .deb is accepted, because every file it ships is Apache-2.0; the Artistic-or-GPL-1+ stanza names a build-time source-tree helper that is not in the package. The licence reviews themselves remain the user's (questions 6 and 247).
